note: Declared search history for deflated-Sharpe correction (KAN-38). Every search that could have produced a candidate now under evaluation gets an entry here, before that candidate is scored. Adding a strategy, a factor, or a parameterization sweep means adding to this file in the same commit -- see docs/operations/edge-validation-framework.md. Each sleeve-level entry also lists its trials with the annualised full-sample Sharpe each scored at its own verdict of record and its objective ('return' or 'insurance'): D22 estimates SR*'s spread from every return-objective trial on record, not only the survivors in a run (docs/decisions/sr-star-spread-2026-10.md). A new candidate is listed here, objective included, before it is scored; its Sharpe is filled in at its verdict.
